newsitem.title: USA: Simpson revises confirmed new orders.
newsitem.headline: Simpson revises confirmed new orders.

text.p: Simpson Industries Inc said Tuesday it believes a part of its new business awards may be in question, so that confirmed new business through September 30 stands at more than $40 million.
On October 7, the company said new business awards reached over $65 million as of September 30.
While the order met its criteria for confirmed new business, in this case the order may have been placed prematurely, said Simpson.
Simpson supplies powertrain and chassis products to original equipment manufacturers.
